method: Constrained least squares over all 98 physical coefficients with PSD pseudo-inertia constraints, broad task bounds, weak scaled ridge regularization, and a 0.03 kg*m^2 armature floor selected using forward measurements and checked by leave-one-recording-out fitting.
limitations: Individual link parameters are not uniquely identifiable; about 69 combinations are resolved by the supplied regressor.
Filtered/interpolated measured torque identifies effective dynamics, not raw motor commands.
The independent 16-recording test fold was neither accessed nor evaluated.
input_integrity: All task-provided input hashes and the geometry hash match.
dataset: LIP4RobotInverseDynamics, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.12516500, CC-BY-SA-4.0; MERL (Giacomuzzo, Carli, Romeres, Dalla Libera), 2024.
